title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Sri Sakthi Cinemas is a growing cinema chain that began in 2002 with a single screen in Tirupur and has expanded to an 8\-screen multiplex in Tirupur and a 3\-screen multiplex in Dharapuram. The company is recognized for delivering high\-quality ambiance, advanced sound and projection systems, and attentive service to create outstanding movie experiences. Sri Sakthi Cinemas focuses on customer delight through modern facilities and consistent service standards. The organization is now expanding operations to Coimbatore, Erode, and Pollachi, offering career opportunities in a dynamic entertainment environment.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Human Resources Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Erode. This role is responsible for managing end\-to\-end HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee engagement for cinema and corporate staff. The Human Resources Manager will develop and implement HR policies, handle employee relations, manage payroll inputs and attendance records, and ensure compliance with labor laws and company standards. The role also involves coordinating training and development programs, supporting workforce planning for new locations, and partnering with management to build a positive, inclusive workplace culture.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should have minimum 4 to 8 years relevant HR experience.
* Candidates should possess strong HR operations and administration skills, including recruitment, onboarding, and employee lifecycle management.
* Candidates should possess capabilities in performance management, employee engagement, and conflict resolution.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of labor laws, HR policies, and compliance practices relevant to the cinema and retail entertainment sector.
* Candidates should possess skills in payroll coordination, attendance management, and HR documentation.
* Relevant experience as an HR Manager or HR Generalist, preferably in hospitality, retail, or entertainment, is beneficial.



  





 Location \- Tirupur
 



 Salary \- 3 to 5 LPA
 



 Experience \- 4 to 8 year only consider
 



 Contact No \- 7094222756
 



  





 IMMEDIATELY JOINERS REQUIRED

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
**Company Description** 
 Terra Tech Packs is a Coimbatore\-based manufacturer specializing in high\-quality reusable food containers, using premium raw materials and modern machinery to ensure consistent product standards. The company has earned a strong reputation in the market through its expertise, reliability, and focus on quality. Terra Tech Packs is committed to making reusable food storage solutions easy and cost\-effective to use at scale. The company aims to build a marketplace for reusable food containers that connects businesses across the industry and supports sustainable practices.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Human Resources Intern role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Coimbatore. The intern will also help coordinate employee engagement initiatives, assist in administering basic employee benefits processes, and provide general administrative support to the HR team.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in MS Office tools and comfort working with HR\-related software and databases.
* Ability to work collaboratively in an on\-site team environment and maintain confidentiality with sensitive information.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
**Company Description** 
 techjays is dedicated to helping the world reimagine a better future with AI, focusing on practical, impactful technology solutions for businesses and communities. The company works on innovative AI\-driven projects that aim to transform how organizations operate and make decisions. Team members collaborate across disciplines to build tools and products that are both scalable and user\-centric. Joining techjays offers an opportunity to contribute to meaningful AI initiatives in a dynamic, growth\-oriented environment.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time Technical Recruiter role based in Coimbatore with a hybrid work model, allowing a combination of onsite and work\-from\-home flexibility. The Technical Recruiter will manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and coordinating hiring processes for technical and related roles. Day\-to\-day tasks include partnering with hiring managers to understand role requirements, creating job postings, building talent pipelines, and maintaining candidate relationships. The role also involves evaluating technical skill sets, managing interview logistics, providing feedback to candidates, and ensuring a positive and inclusive candidate experience. The Technical Recruiter will track hiring metrics, use recruitment tools and platforms, and contribute to continuous improvement of hiring practices.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong full\-life cycle recruiting and general recruiting skills, with experience managing end\-to\-end hiring processes.
* Proficiency in technical recruiting and hiring for engineering, data, and technology\-focused roles.
* Excellent communication skills, including clear written communication and effective stakeholder engagement.
* Experience using applicant tracking systems, professional networks, and sourcing tools to identify and engage talent.
* Ability to assess candidate fit based on skills, experience, and alignment with organizational values.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple requisitions simultaneously.
* Comfort working in a hybrid environment, collaborating with distributed teams and adapting to changing priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Previous experience recruiting in technology or AI\-focused organizations is a plus.

title: Workday HCM/Security and Recruiting Senior Analyst
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Workday HCM, Recruiting \& Security Analyst is responsible for functional leadership, solution design, administration, optimization, and ongoing ownership of Workday HCM, Recruiting, and Security as a key member of the Global HR Shared Services team.
   

  

 This role acts as a Workday strategic partner to HR Centers of Excellence, HR Shared Services, business stakeholders, HR Product Owners, IT, and downstream technology teams. The role will translate business requirements into scalable Workday solutions, leveraging configuration, process design, and practical workarounds to address complex business needs.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring prior Workday implementation and/or consulting experience, with the ability to connect the dots across the technology ecosystem, understand downstream impacts, and design solutions that balance business needs, system capabilities, user experience, and long\-term sustainability.
   

  

 This position will lead and contribute to Workday enhancements, implementations, organizational changes, releases, and special projects.
   

  

 Reporting to the HR Shared Services Leader, this role combines Workday security expertise, functional knowledge, solution architecture, business partnership, implementation experience, and leadership thinking to continuously improve the HR technology landscape.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Workday HCM**
* Own the functional design and optimization of Workday HCM business processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable Workday solutions.
* Evaluate Workday functionality and develop configuration\-based solutions and practical workarounds where standard functionality does not fully meet business needs.
* Connect requirements across Workday modules and consider upstream and downstream impacts when designing solutions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to HR Product Owners and business stakeholders on Workday capabilities, limitations, and solution options.


**Workday Security**
* Serve as a functional SME for Workday Security, ensuring solutions align with business requirements, organizational structures, and governance standards.
* Design and implement Workday security solutions in conjunction with HCM and other module business processes, with strong knowledge of Workday security group types, including Intersection, Aggregation, and Mixed security groups, and their application in designing complex access requirements.
* Assess the impact of organizational and business process changes on security and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Apply a solution architect mindset across functional areas, considering the broader Workday ecosystem rather than individual modules in isolation.
* Identify dependencies and downstream impacts and proactively engage the appropriate stakeholders.


**Special Projects \& Business Transformation**
* Lead and participate in Workday enhancements, implementations, organizational changes, and strategic HR technology initiatives across the solution lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design through testing, deployment, and stabilization.
* Assess the impact of organizational changes and business priorities across modules. Lead UAT, regression, release testing, and implementation activities.
* HCM and Security, Recruiting and exposure to Compensation is considered a strong advantage
* Evaluate solution options and drive delivery by balancing business needs, user experience, scalability, and sustainability while proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and opportunities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of experience working with Workday HCM and Security preferably in a Workday implementation or consulting environment.
* Workday certifications in HCM is a must and any Advanced Modules is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience with Workday implementations, enhancements, configuration projects, or complex solution design.
* Experience translating business requirements into Workday functional solutions and developing configuration\-based workarounds.
* Experience with Workday Recruiting configuration, business processes, supporting Business as Usual, releases, and deployment activities.
* Strong understanding of cross\-functional dependencies between Workday modules and downstream technologies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to independently assess complex requirements and recommend solutions.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt solutions to changing business needs.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence global stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Working knowledge of Workday Compensation and related business processes.
* Experience designing solutions across multiple Workday modules.
* Experience supporting organizational restructuring, business transformation, or significant changes in business processes.


**Who We Are**
 Mold\-Masters (www.moldmasters.com) is a leading global supplier of hot runners, controllers, auxiliary injection and co\-injection systems. We design, manufacture, distribute, sell and service highly engineered and customized plastic processing equipment that caters to every market. Mold\-Masters is a business unit of Hillenbrand.
   

  

 Hillenbrand (www.hillenbrand.com) is a global industrial company that provides highly engineered, mission\-critical processing equipment and solutions to customers in over 100 countries around the world. Our portfolio is composed of leading industrial brands that serve large, attractive end markets, including durable plastics, food, and recycling. Guided by our Purpose — Shape What Matters For Tomorrow™ — we pursue excellence, collaboration, and innovation to consistently shape solutions that best serve our associates, customers, communities, and other stakeholders.

title: Head of Human Resources - NBFC
description:

 Dhanam Investment and Finance Private Limited is a professionally managed Non\-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) focused on responsible, transparent, and technology\-driven financial solutions. The company serves individuals, professionals, and small businesses through products such as Gold Loans, Loan Against Property, Non\-Convertible Debentures, Corporate Loans, and secure private locker facilities. Its locker services provide safe storage for valuables and documents, backed by strong security and controlled access, reflecting a commitment to customer safety and privacy. Dhanam emphasizes financial discipline, robust risk management, modern digital platforms, and strong governance with a customer\-first approach. The organization continues to strengthen its technology, operations, and compliance to support responsible growth and build accessible, dependable financial pathways for India’s growing economy.
 



  





**Job Details:** 




**Designation:** 
 Head – Human Resources
 



**Department:** 
 Human Resources
 



**Reporting To:** 
 CEO
 



**Location:** 
 Head Office
 



**Industry:** 
 NBFC/ Banking (Mandatory)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**Experience:** 




**Preferred:** 
 10 years of HR experience.
 



 Candidates with
 **NBFC experience will be preferred** 
 .
 



 Prior experience as Head HR, Deputy Head HR, Regional HR Head, Senior HR Business Partner or HR Operations Head would be advantageous.
 



  





**Key Competencies** 




 The candidate should demonstrate:
 


* Strong leadership
* Strategic and hands\-on HR capability
* Recruitment expertise
* Organisation\-building experience
* Performance\-management expertise
* Strong employee\-relations capability
* Ability to handle disciplinary matters
* Strong HR analytics and MIS skills
* Commercial understanding
* Strong communication and negotiation
* High integrity and confidentiality
* Ability to manage multi\-location teams
* Strong technology orientation



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate should be able to operate at three levels:
 



**Strategic:** 
 Organisation design, manpower planning, leadership hiring, succession and culture.
 



**Managerial:** 
 Policies, systems, compensation, performance management, dashboards and training.
 



**Operational:** 
 Recruitment, branch staffing, attrition control, disciplinary matters, employee disputes and senior\-level hiring.
 



  





 The Company is looking for a
 **strong, hands\-on HR leader who can build a scalable HR function and support the growth of a regulated financial\-services organisation.** 




  





**JOB DESCRIPTION:** 




 The Head – Human Resources will lead the complete HR function and partner with the CEO and senior leadership to build a high\-performance, disciplined, scalable and compliant organisation.
 



  





 The role requires a strong, hands\-on HR leader with expertise in manpower planning, recruitment, branch staffing, performance management, compensation, employee relations, HR compliance, learning and development, succession planning and HR technology.
 



  





**Experience in an NBFC/ Banking is mandatory.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. HR Strategy \& Organisation Development** 



* Develop and implement HR strategy aligned with business growth.
* Design organisation structures, reporting hierarchies, grades and manpower plans.
* Establish manpower norms for branches and departments.
* Develop job descriptions, competency frameworks and career paths.
* Support organisation restructuring and workforce optimisation.
* Develop succession plans for critical positions.
* Build leadership and internal talent pipelines.



  





**2\. Manpower Planning** 



* Prepare annual manpower plans based on branch expansion, business growth, AUM, customer base, portfolio size and productivity.
* Monitor approved versus actual headcount.
* Review manpower productivity and control unnecessary hiring.
* Develop branch and department staffing models.



  





**3\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition** 




**Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for:** 



* Branch Managers
* Sales and Relationship Managers
* Gold Loan teams
* LAP and other lending teams
* Credit
* Collections
* Operations
* Finance \& Accounts
* Compliance
* Risk
* Internal Audit
* Technology
* Corporate functions
* Senior management



 Responsibilities include sourcing, interviews, assessments, compensation negotiation, background verification, reference checks, recruitment vendor management and hiring TAT.
 



  





**4\. Branch Staffing** 



* Build scalable recruitment processes for branch expansion.
* Create local talent pools.
* Conduct recruitment drives.
* Monitor branch vacancies.
* Ensure critical roles are filled before branch launch.
* Monitor early attrition.



  





**5\. Employee Onboarding** 




**Establish structured onboarding covering:** 



* Offer and appointment letters
* Employee documentation
* Background verification
* KYC
* Confidentiality undertaking
* Code of Conduct
* Conflict\-of\-interest declaration
* Policy acknowledgement
* Induction and functional training



  





**6\. Performance Management** 




**Develop and manage a measurable Performance Management System covering:** 



* KRAs and KPIs
* Goal setting
* Monthly / quarterly reviews
* Annual appraisal
* Promotions
* Increments
* Variable pay
* Performance Improvement Plans
* Recognition
* Succession planning



 Ensure KPIs are appropriate for each function and do not encourage poor customer conduct, weak credit quality or regulatory breaches.
 



  





**7\. Compensation \& Benefits** 



* Design salary and grade structures.
* Develop incentive and variable\-pay frameworks.
* Manage annual increments and employee benefits.
* Benchmark compensation against relevant industry levels.
* Ensure compensation structures support performance without creating excessive risk\-taking.



  





**8\. Payroll Governance** 



* Ensure accurate monthly payroll.
* Validate attendance, leave, incentives and deductions.
* Maintain controls over salary changes.
* Coordinate statutory deductions.
* Monitor joining and exit settlements.
* Ensure timely full and final settlement.



  





**9\. Employee Relations \& Discipline** 



* Employee grievances
* Workplace conflicts
* Absenteeism
* Poor performance
* Misconduct
* Disciplinary matters
* Employee complaints
* Manager\-employee disputes



 Establish processes for show\-cause notices, investigations, enquiries, warnings, suspension and termination.
 



 Work with Compliance, Risk, Audit and Legal in cases involving fraud, cash irregularities, document manipulation, data misuse, bribery, conflict of interest and serious misconduct.
 



  





**10\. Learning \& Development** 




 Build structured training programmes covering:
 


* Employee induction
* Leadership development
* Product training
* Sales
* Credit
* Collections
* Operations
* Customer service
* KYC / AML awareness
* Fair Practices Code
* Information security
* Data privacy
* POSH
* Code of Conduct

**11\. Leadership \& Succession** 



* Identify high\-potential employees.
* Develop future Branch Managers and Regional Managers.
* Build functional leadership pipelines.
* Promote internal career progression.
* Maintain succession plans for critical positions.



  





**12\. Attrition \& Retention** 



* Overall attrition
* Branch\-wise attrition
* Department\-wise attrition
* Role\-wise attrition
* Early attrition
* High\-performer attrition



 Conduct exit interviews and initiate corrective actions based on trends.
 



  





**13\. HR Compliance** 




 Ensure compliance with applicable employment and labour requirements including:
 


* PF
* ESI
* Gratuity
* Bonus
* Maternity benefits
* Leave requirements
* Shops and Establishments requirements
* POSH
* Employment documentation
* Statutory registers

**14\. HR Policies** 




 Develop and maintain policies covering:
 


* Recruitment
* Background verification
* Probation
* Attendance and Leave
* Transfers and Promotions
* Performance Management
* Incentives
* Code of Conduct
* Disciplinary Action
* Travel and Reimbursements
* POSH
* Conflict of Interest
* Whistleblower

* Separation

* Employee master

* Attendance
* Leave
* Payroll
* Performance management
* Training
* Document management

* Headcount

* Payroll and manpower cost
* Branch productivity
* Employee tenure

title: Manager – Campus Recruitment & University Hiring
description:
**Summary:** 




 Soliton is a high\-technology software company working with leading semiconductor industries globally, and currently we are looking for a Manager – Campus Recruitment \& University Hiring. This role focuses on driving campus hiring strategies, building strong university partnerships, and attracting top early\-career talent across key industries. The Manager will handle end\-to\-end campus recruitment, stakeholder management, and ensure a seamless candidate experience. This position requires a strategic approach to strengthen employer branding and build a robust talent pipeline aligned with business goals.
 



  





**Position Overview:** 




 This multi\-faced role plays a pivotal role in our organization's talent acquisition and brand\-building efforts. The incumbent will be not just responsible for recruiting talent but also for building relationships, representing the Soliton brand, and helping foster educational excellence in our partner institutions.
 



  





**Job Description:** 




**Campus Hiring:** 



* Design and execute a comprehensive campus hiring strategy and plan that is aligned with the company's talent acquisition goals and objectives.
* Identify target campuses and cultivate relationships with key stakeholders, including principals, placement officers, faculty members, and student clubs.
* Work closely with hiring managers to understand their talent requirements and develop tailored campus recruitment plans for specific roles and departments.
* Continuously assess and refine the campus hiring strategy based on feedback, performance metrics, and evolving market trends.
* Collaborate closely with the hiring team to optimize the campus hiring process, improve candidate quality, and enhance overall efficiency.
* Plan, coordinate, and execute campus recruitment events, encompassing campus drives, pre\-placement talks, and technical and cultural fit assessments.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to ensure seamless coordination of logistics, branding materials, interview schedules, and candidate evaluations.



  





**Employer Branding and Relationship Building:**

title: TC - CS - Senior - DPP - FY 27 Proactive Hiring - Data Privacy
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\- Cyber Security (DPP) – Technology Consulting –** 
**Senior**
 As part of our EY Cyber security, Technology Consulting team, your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You will be responsible for delivery and maintaining quality of services and deliverables on your engagements. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY and GDS within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate. Similarly, you’ll anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Senior Consultant who help our clients improve their security and data protection posture to respond to the dynamic data and security threats. You will provide data privacy and protection domain expertise and utilise your business insight to work closely with our clients to advise, design, build, deploy and test pragmatic security solutions that will give real and tangible benefits and security enhancement. In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture and help fellow team members to develop and grow together.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the execution of comprehensive Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) and Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) for clients, identifying potential data privacy risks and providing their remediation plans.
* Develop and implement robust consent management frameworks to ensure clients' adherence to data subject consent requirements as per applicable regulations.
* Conduct in\-depth data privacy gap assessments and maturity assessments to identify areas for improvement and guide clients in developing a strategic roadmap for program enhancement.
* Provide strategic guidance on data subject rights, including access requests, rectification requests, and erasure requests.
* Craft and implement effective incident response plans to manage data breaches and privacy incidents, minimizing risk and upholding regulatory compliance.
* Develop and maintain Records of Processing Activities (RoPAs) for clients, ensuring transparency and accountability.
* Partner with clients to develop and maintain comprehensive privacy policies and procedures that align with industry best practices and applicable data privacy regulations.
* Cultivate a deep understanding of the latest data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, DPDPA, China PIPL, etc) and advise clients on their potential business implications.
* Facilitate training sessions for both internal and client teams to raise awareness of data privacy best practices.
* Effectively manage stakeholder relationships, ensuring clear communication and project alignment.
* Foster strong collaboration with colleagues across diverse disciplines (e.g., legal, technology) to deliver holistic privacy solutions to clients.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Relevant work Experience: 4 to 6 years.
* Proven track record of successfully conducting PIAs, DPIAs, privacy gap assessments, and privacy maturity assessments for diverse clients.
* In\-depth knowledge of data subject rights and experience in supporting clients with their fulfilment.
* A proven ability to develop and implement data breach response plans and manage privacy incidents effectively.
* Experience in developing privacy strategies and roadmaps.
* Experience in planning and implementation of privacy controls.
* Strong understanding on RoPA documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to craft and maintain comprehensive privacy policies and procedures.
* Proficiency in a variety of data privacy regulations, including GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, DPDPA etc.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to identify complex privacy issues and develop practical solutions.
* A passion for data privacy and a commitment to staying current with evolving industry trends and regulations.
* Good Understanding of risk assessment frameworks.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Graduates / BE \- B. Tech / MCA / M. Sc (Stats, Maths, Computer Science) / MBA with background in computer science and programming.
* Certifications related to Data Privacy such as CIPP, CIPM, CIPT etc.
* Functional and non\-functional privacy requirements definition and documentation experience.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management skills.
* CISSP, CISA, CISM, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor and Lead Implementer.


**What We Look For**
* A team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1400 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
